record.question: Which of the following legalized the company's control over Bengal?
options: The treaty with Mir Jafar after the Battle of Plassey (1757)
The treaty with Mir Jafar after the Battle of Buxar (1764)
The treaty of February 1765 with Nizam-ud-Daula
The imperial grant of the Diwani of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa by Shah Alam II
record.explanation: The Diwani grant by Shah Alam II legalized Company control.
